title: 2017 Bowman Chrome Draft Refractors #BDC194 Logan Warmoth
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2017 Bowman Chrome Draft Refractors trading card features Logan Warmoth of the Toronto Blue Jays. The card is an original from the manufacturer, Topps Co., and has a chrome refractor finish. It is a single card in the set and has the card number BDC 194. 

The card is in near mint/mint condition and is a modern (1970-now) period sports trading card. The type is a sports trading card and the season is 2017. The card is an original and comes from the Bowman brand. This is a great addition to any baseball card collection.
